verdict.rationale: Llama.com docs assert 'a drop-in replacement is possible' and mention function-calling/agent-optimized inference, implying OpenAI-compatible API usage, but there is no concrete migration guide, code sample, or SDK adapter shown, and the docs pages themselves were found gated behind an SSO wall, undermining public accessibility of any such guide. No openapi spec or llms.txt was found either. missing for 10: an actual documented step-by-step migration/adapter guide, sample code showing OpenAI SDK pointed at Llama endpoints, publicly accessible (non-gated) docs, and independent confirmation that the drop-in claim works in practice.
